Designme Soft 2

Soft 2

Every component rebuilt to live inside the agent's own thread: one quiet surface per object, grey type for finished work, and slow, blurred motion only on what is happening now. 103 of 103 rebuilt so far.

Accent
Part one

Agent components

Agent status

What the agent is doing, how far along it is, and what it is working with.

Status pill

One live line for what the agent is doing right now.

Press Review when it asks

Step loader

Named steps with a progress track and four loaders.

Click the row to see every step

Thinking states

Six thinking indicators to pick from, each with a status line.

Switch between the six states

Reasoning trail

The agent's plan, notes, sources and edits, after it thinks.

Switch tabs, open the header

Thinking

The live trace, written as the agent works, then folded away.

Click the header to open it again

Agent phases

One line for which phase the agent is in, from thinking to done, that stops to ask you, says when it is slow, and folds to how long it took.

Approve when it asks, open it once it is done

Context meter

How full the context is and what fills it, with Compact to free room.

Hover a part, then compact

Action log

Every read, search, edit and command, logged as it runs.

Click any step for the detail

Run queue

Agent jobs running, up next and done, with progress, retries and a compact view.

Retry the failed step, try Compact

Agent tree

An orchestrator and its sub-agents, with cost rolled up per branch.

Fold a branch, hover a cost

Agent inbox

Every run that needs you, is running or is done, in one list.

Approve a run, retry a failure

Browser session

The agent browsing for you, step by step, with Pause and Take over.

Allow it past the banner, or take over

Web search

The agent's searches as a trail: what it asked, what came back, what it read or skipped, and the answer with its sources.

Open a search, point at a source

Trace view

One agent run as a waterfall of spans, with latency and tokens.

Open a span to see its input and output

Run cost

Live credit and token spend, with a cap that pauses the run.

Start a run and watch the cap

Toast

One notification that changes shape with its state.

Pick a state, try Undo

Toast stack

Agent notifications that stack and fan out on hover.

Hover the stack, send another

Run summary

What the agent did, what changed and what needs you.

Review the open item, try Undo all

Error and recovery

A failed step with retry, skip or hand over to a person.

Pick a way forward and continue

Agent lanes

Several agents working in parallel, each with its own lane and hand-offs.

Pause all, or open a lane

Agent run timeline

Every model and tool step of a run on one time axis.

Hover a bar for its time and cost

Conversation

Asking, answering and replying, by text or by voice.

Live answer

Answers that stream in with numbered sources and next steps.

Hover a source number, pick a follow-up

Thread panel

Switch between agent threads and reply in place.

Switch threads, send a reply

Composer

Message input with attachments, what to work on, a mode and dictation.

Attach a frame, pick a mode, send

Rich text editor

A minimal editor with an inline AI menu that streams a suggestion to accept or discard.

Select a sentence, ask AI to shorten it, accept it

Voice capture

Talk to the agent, then fix what it misheard before sending.

Tap a highlighted word to fix it

Voice orb

A hands-free voice chat, with an orb that shows who is talking.

Start, mute and end. It never uses your microphone

Tool call

Each tool the agent calls, with its input and output.

Open a call to see what went in and out

Artifact card

A file the agent made, with its versions, Open, Copy and Download.

Open it, pick a version, copy or download it

Image generation

A prompt with styles, shape and count, pictures that resolve out of grain, and a gallery of earlier ones.

Generate, retry, upscale, open a picture, pick a style

Prompt starters

Suggested tasks that fill the composer in one click.

Pick a starter, or shuffle

Prompt library

Saved prompts with blanks to fill in before they go to the agent.

Open a prompt and fill in its blanks

Attachment tray

Drop files for the agent and watch each one upload.

Drop real files, or add samples

Response versions

Regenerate an answer and flip between versions.

Regenerate, then page through versions

Feedback sheet

Rate an answer and tell the agent what missed.

Thumbs down opens the reasons

Model picker

Pick a model by speed, quality and cost, and how hard it thinks.

Hover a meter, pick a model, set the thinking

Answer action bar

Copy, regenerate, rate and listen to an answer from one row under it.

Listen, rate it down, pick why, then copy the fix

Review and approve

Where a person checks, steers or signs off on the agent's work.

Decision prompt

The agent asks a few quick questions before it starts.

Pick with 1, 2, 3 or click

Proposal card

A suggested change with confidence, alternatives and undo.

Compare options, then accept

Rewrite toolbar

Select a sentence and let the agent rewrite it in place.

Click a sentence, then pick a rewrite

Design tuner

Tweak a component by hand or let the agent tune it.

Drag the sliders or tune with the agent

Permission gate

The agent asks before it touches something new.

Choose scopes and how long, then allow

Hand-off to a person

The agent hands a conversation to a person, with what they need to pick it up.

Reassign it, or edit what the customer was told

Launch checklist

The agent checks a design before it ships, and fixes what fails.

Run the checks, then fix the failures

Plan review

Check the agent's plan, edit steps, then let it run.

Edit or skip a step, then approve

Change review

Accept or reject each change the agent made, file by file.

Keep or undo each change, comment on a line

Inline text diff

The agent's edits to a piece of copy, accepted or rejected one by one.

Click an edit to accept or reject it

Draft review

An email the agent drafted, to check and edit before it sends.

Edit the draft, then send, schedule or discard it

Steering

Change the agent's course while it works, without starting over.

Send a change mid-run

Eval results

An eval run case by case, against the run before.

Run the evals, open a failed case

Design review

Checks run, a teammate asks for a change, the agent makes it, and you ship.

Watch the review, then choose how it ships

Sources and output

What the agent read, what it made, and where each answer came from.

Source stack

Everything the agent read, folded into one quiet pill.

Open the stack, filter by type

Metric insight

A number, its trend, and the agent's read on why it moved.

Hover the chart, ask why it moved

Task table

Agent tasks in a sortable table with bulk actions.

Sort a column, select rows

Code viewer

Code the agent wrote, with line notes you can ask about.

Switch files, click a line to ask

Terminal stream

Shell commands the agent runs, with their output as it streams in.

Open the folded output, stop a command or copy it all

Details panel

Properties of a run you can change in place.

Change status, owner or model inline

Citation hover card

Hover a citation to see the exact passage it came from.

Hover or click a citation

Field extraction

The agent pulls fields out of a document and shows where each came from.

Hover a field to find it, fix the unsure one

Workspace

Navigation, settings, models and automations around the agent.

Workspace rail

A slim app rail that opens into a labelled sidebar.

Hover icons, pin it open

Command palette

Jump anywhere or hand a task to the agent from one box.

Type to filter, arrows and Enter to run

Agent settings

How much the agent may do alone, with a save bar for changes.

Change anything to see the save bar

Agent builder

Describe an agent in a sentence and it drafts the rest: who it is, what it may do, what it knows, when it runs. Test it, save it, publish it.

Edit a drafted field, test it, then publish

File explorer

Project files, with the ones the agent touched marked.

Open folders, filter to changed files

Automation canvas

A trigger, a few agent steps, and a run you can watch flow through.

Click + to add a step, drag them around, then run

Canvas toolbar

A floating toolbar for a workflow canvas: run, pick a tool, comment, fit and zoom.

Pan with the hand, zoom in, fit, then run

Memory panel

What the agent remembers about your team, editable and removable.

Edit or forget a memory, watch it learn and get used

Model compare

Run one prompt on three models side by side and keep the best.

Run the prompt, swap a model, use the best answer

Tools and connections

The tools the agent can reach, and how much it may do with each.

Set Ask or Allow, test a connection

Knowledge sources

The files, sites and folders the agent knows, and how far each is indexed.

Add a website, retry the file that failed

Scheduled runs

Tasks the agent runs on a schedule, with their last result and a switch.

Run one now, pause one, make a new one

Harness

A live agent conversation built only from the components above.

Agent harness

Every component working together in one agent app.

Type a message, or open a chat
Part two

App basics

Charts and tables

Lightweight charts and tables for dashboards.

Line chart

Two series over time with a hover readout and toggles.

Hover the chart, toggle a series

Bar chart

Weekly agent runs, split by outcome, with a range switch.

Hover a bar, switch the range

Donut chart

Where the agent's time went, by kind of task.

Hover a slice or a row

Radial goals

Each agent's share of its own target as a ring, with the overall score in the middle.

Hover a ring or a row, switch the range

Funnel

Signup to paid, with the biggest drop called out by the agent.

Hover a step, switch the segment

Top pages

Most visited pages with share of traffic and a quick sort.

Sort by views or change, hover a page

Health score

A design system score made of a few checks you can open.

Open a check, let the agent fix it

Score breakdown

A score out of 100 whose gauge is split by what goes into it, with the weakest part flagged and a fix to try.

Hover a factor, open one and improve it

Eval radar

This run against the baseline on six eval scores, with the weak ones flagged.

Hover or tab to an axis, toggle a series

Cost vs quality

Every run as a dot by cost and eval score, sized by tokens, with quadrants and a drag to select.

Hover a dot, drag across the chart to select

Activity heatmap

When the agent and the team were busy, by day and hour.

Hover a cell, switch who

Stat cards

Four headline numbers with sparklines and a period switch.

Switch the period, hover a card

Account table

Customer accounts with health, plan and an agent note per row.

Search, filter by plan, open a row

Dates

Pickers, calendars and agendas.

Date picker

A field that opens a calendar, with quick picks and natural language.

Open it, type “next friday” or pick a day

Segmented control

Switch between views of the same thing, with a sliding indicator.

Pick a view, step through dates, or open a day

Date range picker

Pick a start and end across two months, or use a preset.

Click two days, or pick a preset

Event calendar

A week view where the agent finds a free slot for you.

Open or drag an event, click a free slot to add one

Agenda

Today's schedule with a live now line and agent prep notes.

Open an event to see the agent's prep

Forms and inputs

Buttons, fields and sign-in flows.

Buttons

Every button style, with loading, success and hold-to-confirm states.

Click them all, hold the delete button

Badge

Small labels for plans, environments and status, with a dot, an icon or a remove button.

Remove a badge, then undo it

Tooltip

Quiet labels on hover, with shortcuts and a richer preview card.

Hover each control

Search input

Search with scoped filters, recent queries and an agent answer.

Focus it, type, add a filter with @

Country select

A searchable select with country codes, currency and keyboard support.

Open it, type to filter, use the arrows

Multi-select

A combobox that filters as you type and keeps your picks as chips.

Type, pick with the arrows and Enter

Colour picker

Pick a colour by eye or by hex, check its contrast, and let the agent fix it or make a scale from it.

Drag or use the arrow keys, then ask the agent

Social sign-in

One-tap providers that remember the last one you used.

Pick a provider

Sign in

Email first, then the one-time code from the email, copied or typed in.

Enter any email, then copy the code from the email

OTP field

A one-time code, one box per digit, that fills from a paste.

Paste or type the code

Form

A project brief with inline checks and an agent that drafts the rest.

Fill a field, or let the agent draft

Payment form

Card details with live formatting, brand detection and a clear total.

Type a card number, switch billing period

Carousel

Drafts the agent made to keep one of, or a gallery of pictures, on one swipeable track.

Swipe, drag or use the arrows; switch between drafts and a gallery

Collaboration

Threads, inboxes and boards for teams working alongside an agent.

Comments

A design thread where you can @mention the agent and it replies.

Reply, or mention @agent

Notifications

An inbox where agent updates and mentions arrive live.

Mark read, switch tabs, watch new ones arrive

Banner

An announcement on a tint of its tone, with its own line drawing.

Flip through its styles

Invite

Add teammates by email as chips, set their role, send.

Type emails, press Enter or comma

Reactions

Quick reactions on an agent update, with counts that pop.

React, open the picker, hover a count

Profile menu

The account menu behind an avatar: switch workspace, theme, shortcuts and sign out.

Open the menu, switch workspace, flip the theme

Context menu

Right-click an agent reply for its actions, with a submenu that asks the agent about it.

Right-click or long-press the reply, or Shift+F10

Context switcher

The organisation, project and environment you are in, each part a searchable switcher.

Open a part, type to filter, pick one

Filter menu

Add filters from a menu, see them as chips, and watch the count change.

Add a filter, flip is to is not, remove a chip

Number field

Type a number or step it with minus and plus, with units, limits and a word when a value is changed to fit.

Type a value, press or hold minus and plus, or use the arrow keys

Ticket list

Support tickets the agent has triaged, with suggested replies.

Open a ticket, send the suggested reply

Kanban

A sprint board where you and the agent move cards, with filters, details and keyboard moves.

Drag, filter, open a card, or let the agent finish one

Product

Pricing, onboarding and setup flows.

Pricing cards

Three plans with a billing switch and a seat slider.

Switch billing, drag the seats

Onboarding checklist

First steps with a progress ring, and the agent can do some for you.

Tick steps, or hand one to the agent

Stepper

A multi-step setup with a progress track that fills as you go.

Go next and back, click a finished step

Set limit

A monthly agent budget with a draggable cap and a forecast.

Drag the cap, pick what happens at the limit

Progress and meter

An agent run's progress and what it costs, with a credits meter that warns as it fills.

Pause the run, retry when a step fails

Slider

Named stops, a stepped scale and a range, with the agent's recommended value marked on the track.

Drag a knob, use the arrow keys, or pick a stop

Currency converter

Show plan prices in local currency, with a swap and live rate.

Type an amount, swap, change currency
